title: Search economy code retrieval Q1 enriched single shot and Q2 agentic DAG arm results evidence chunk 3
summary: Q2 MULTI-ROUND AGENTIC / DAG ARM (avenue a: runAgenticContextSearches via GET /subconscious/assignment?agentic_context=1) — does NOT retrieve code_nodes; closed ZERO single-shot misses. Across all 13 queries identically: n_context_selected=1, context_kinds=['task'], confidence=1.0, stop_reason='confidence_high', rounds=2, n_code_selected=0 -> recall 0.000, 0 hits. ROOT CAUSE (lib/subconscious/index.js): the agentic loop runs the task-gated DAG round FIRST; for a freshly-minted bench probe that round selects the probe TASK self-context at confidence 1.0, and agenticStopReason (index.js:711: selected_count>0 && confidence>=HIGH_CONFIDENCE => 'confidence_high') short-circuits BEFORE the broad-RAG round's code-tier hits can be selected. The agentic/DAG context layer is task-DAG-centric (selects related TASK nodes via isAgenticTaskFollowupCandidate, kind==='task'); contextDependencyFromResult does not even carry file/start/end. code_nodes DO flow into the same ragResults pool (tier 'code', memory-search.js) and a plain broad /search surfaces them, but the agentic SELECTION never promotes a code_node. So iterative/DAG retrieval cannot convert single-shot misses for code-nav as currently
